title: Phytip Protein Purification
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired parameters for the Phytip preparation (e.g., select up to 12 samples and configure the 5 required buffers) in the fields provided above the protocol.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it to access the .py file and any supporting files.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the labware JSON files (.json) to upload any custom labware needed for the run.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload the downloaded protocol file with the .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the OT deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the Phytip protein purification.
